name: Daytime and Night
source:
Two years have passed. The four people gather at a forgotten deserted island. Calm days shift interchange crazy nights. Darkness comes to hearts at night, and murderous impulse can no longer be controlled. There must be a way to end these nights.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
两年过去了。四人聚集在一座被遗忘的荒岛上。平静的白天转变为疯狂的夜晚。夜晚，心中一片黑暗，杀气再也无法控制。一定有办法结束这些夜晚。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
